0: One day the Supreme Being took it into his head to give a great banquet in his palace of azure.
1: All the virtues were invited. Only the virtues ... men he did not ask ... only ladies.
2: There were a great many of them, great and small. The lesser virtues were more agreeable and genial than the great ones; but they all appeared in good humour, and chatted amiably together, as was only becoming for near relations and friends.
3: But the Supreme Being noticed two charming ladies who seemed to be totally unacquainted.
4: The Host gave one of the ladies his arm and led her up to the other.
7: Both the virtues were amazed beyond expression; ever since the world had stood, and it had been standing a long time, this was the first time they had met.
_title: The Banquet of the Supreme Being
